record.paper_title: Research Problems in Function Theory (New Edition)
record.original_question: Let S ∗ be the class of all star-like functions f (z) in S. Marx [555] conjectured that for each fixed z0 , |z0 | < 1, the set of all numbers f ′ (z0 ) for f ∈ S ∗ coincides with the set of all number k′ (z), |z| ≤ |z0 |, where z k(z) = (1 − z)2 is the Koebe function. This is known to be true for |z| ≤ 0.736, see Duren [205]. (P. L. Duren)

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $S$ denote the class of functions $f$ analytic and univalent in the unit disk $\mathbb{D}=\{z\in\mathbb{C}:|z|<1\}$ with $f(0)=0$ and $f'(0)=1$. Let $S^*\subset S$ denote the subclass of starlike functions, i.e., those $f\in S$ for which $f(\mathbb{D})$ is starlike with respect to the origin (equivalently, $\operatorname{Re}(zf'(z)/f(z))>0$ for all $z\in\mathbb{D}$). Let $k$ be the Koebe function, $k(z)=z/(1-z)^2$.

For each fixed $z_0\in\mathbb{D}$, define
$$V(z_0)=\{f'(z_0):f\in S^*\}\subset\mathbb{C},\qquad W(z_0)=\{k'(z):|z|\le |z_0|\}\subset\mathbb{C}.$$
Decide whether $V(z_0)=W(z_0)$ for every $z_0\in\mathbb{D}$.
artifact.status_search_result: The Marx conjecture has been verified in the disk |z| ≤ 0.736 by Duren (1965), and further partial progress was made by McLaughlin (1969) and Hummel (1972). No source indicates a full resolution; the conjecture appears to remain open in general.

status_evidence.title: The Marx conjecture for starlike functions (Hummel, 1972)
status_evidence.snippet: J. A. Hummel, Michigan Math. J. 19 (1972) — work on partial progress toward the Marx conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: The Marx conjecture has been investigated with partial results extending Duren's |z|≤0.736 bound.

status_evidence.title: On the Marx conjecture for starlike functions of order a (McLaughlin)
status_evidence.snippet: Renate McLaughlin, Trans. Amer. Math. Soc. 142 (1969).
status_evidence.claim: Studied generalized versions of the Marx conjecture for starlike functions of order α; conjecture not fully resolved.
